behaviour.hover: image saturate 0->1 + scale 1.02 (500ms ease-out); title -> #d52331 with a left-to-right 1px underline (background-size 0%->100%, 500ms)
behaviour.loading: lazy images; grey pulse skeleton behind each image while loading (optional)
behaviour.dataSource: static in delivered HTML; no endpoint

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Promotional cards: greyscale 3:2 image that colours and zooms on hover, red eyebrow, linked title; whole card clickable; 4/2/1 columns

cells: text (richtext): eyebrow p, title p with the link

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 image (+ alt); cell 2 rich text with eyebrow paragraph and a title paragraph containing the link

usage: Home 'Fresh insights' section (heading is default content in the same section).
reuseGuidance: Any grid of promo / teaser links with an image.
